scripts.check: npm run check:types && npm run lint && npm run check:types:unit_tests

scripts.check:demo: npm run check:demo:types && npm run lint:demo

scripts.test:integration:firefox: npm run --silent test:integration:notice && cross-env BROWSER_CONFIG=firefox vitest run tests/integration/scenarios

~~~ Integration tests have two dependencies: a local RxPlayer build and ffmpeg.

~~~ 2.  You built an up-to-date RxPlayer through the \`build\` npm script.
"
